svg.text: DIAGRAM FROM THE PLAN DATA (shared/src/queens): every building footprint generated from its block's typology. Not a screenshot; not built yet.
940 x 690 m. Under each place: the fastest and slowest fort's time to its door, empty-handed, sprinting (ESTIMATED from measured speeds). All plan rules pass.

Each block is washed and outlined in its tier's colour (orange low, green mid, purple high, red special) over the physical city. Black dots: front doors; white: second ways out; black squares: the line's columns.
